description: [$0.002] Fetch any public HTTPS webpage with SSRF protection, strip navigation/ad boilerplate, and return clean LLM-ready Markdown, word count, and extracted entities as JSON. Do not use for searching across sites (use web_search) or auditing x402 endpoints (use x402_endpoint_audit). Only `summarize=true` invokes the local LLM, and expiring `timeout_ms` returns `degraded=true` with extracted Markdown but no summary. Live SSRF-guarded HTTPS fetch, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

summarize.description: Add LLM-powered summary with entity extraction and sentiment scoring

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

url.description: Any public URL to fetch, clean, and extract content from

name: web_fetch_markdown
title: Clean markdown from URL
